text: 754 replaces real dynamic server ports and directly assigned passwords with the fixed test.test proxy endpoint and saved login-manager credentials. Current IMAP and POP setup retains protocol-specific login origins. The observable server endpoint and credential realm must match the NetworkTestUtils setup; the fake server listening port alone is not the account address. This does not prescribe these fake hostnames for product account settings.
title: Use the configured proxy hostname and protocol login realm in mail tests
